definition.candidate_set: top-K of the FROZEN STAT-DE-v1 reported_rank, intersected with the background population (analysis_eligible_primary genes that carry at least one annotation in the reference). Genes outside that population cannot contribute a hit and are excluded from n.
definition.candidate_n_means: the number of candidates actually tested, which is smaller than K when some top-K genes carry no annotation
definition.background: analysis_eligible_primary genes present in the pathway reference (10,682 genes)
definition.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across ALL testable pathways (11,561), not only those with a candidate hit
definition.testable_pathway: reference pathway with at least one background gene
definition.status: exploratory only — no significance threshold is applied by the application

note: These are the frozen values the application must reproduce. The app computes the same statistic at runtime for arbitrary gene sets (e.g. a user shortlist); a test asserts the runtime result equals these numbers for K = 20 / 50 / 100.
